therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor angiogenesis and growth factor signaling
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with osteosarcoma metastatic to the lung
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: 4-month Progression Free Survival (PFS) per RECIST version 1.1 guidelines

results.dose_information: 800mg once daily for subjects >18 years and subjects 16-17 years with BSA ≥1.6; 600mg once daily for subjects 16-17 years with BSA <1.6 m2; continuous 28-day cycles

context.duration: continuous treatment until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity
